response.rationale: For the sense of locating or discovering something, Indonesian commonly uses “menemukan,” while Malaysian Malay commonly uses “menemui.” The forms teach a useful everyday variety preference, though “menemui” has a different common sense of meeting in Indonesian.
response.risk_rationale: “Menemui” is also commonly understood as meeting or visiting someone in Indonesian, so context may be needed for learners.
response.shared_synonym_rationale: “Menjumpai” can occur in both varieties for finding or encountering something, but it is less neutral or less preferred than the proposed form in this contrast, so the national preference remains useful.
